```{r setup}
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(targets)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(Seurat)
library(SeuratObject)
library(CellChat)
library(patchwork)

options(stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

CONDITION_LABEL    <- "WT"
CLUSTER_COL_HSC    <- "sNN_pca.SCT_30_res.0.9"
CLUSTER_COL_MNC    <- "sNN_pca.SCT_30_res.0.9"
CLUSTER_COL_STROMA <- "sNN_pca.SCT_30_res.0.9"

DE_TARGET_HSC    <- "cluster_de_each_vs_rest_hsc_0_9"
DE_TARGET_MNC    <- "cluster_de_each_vs_rest_mnc_0_9"
DE_TARGET_STROMA <- "cluster_de_each_vs_rest_stroma_0_9"

DE_LOGFC_MIN <- 0.5
DE_PADJ_MAX  <- 0.01
```

## Load and merge compartments

```{r load-merge}
#| message: false

srt_merged <- tar_read(mpn_wt_all)
DefaultAssay(srt_merged) <- "RNA"
srt_merged <- SeuratObject::JoinLayers(srt_merged)
srt_merged <- NormalizeData(srt_merged, normalization.method = "LogNormalize", scale.factor = 1e4, verbose = FALSE)

md <- srt_merged@meta.data
srt_merged$labels <- dplyr::case_when(
  md$compartment == "HSC"    ~ paste0("HSC_c",    md[[CLUSTER_COL_HSC]]),
  md$compartment == "MNC"    ~ paste0("MNC_c",    md[[CLUSTER_COL_MNC]]),
  md$compartment == "Stroma" ~ paste0("Stroma_c", md[[CLUSTER_COL_STROMA]]),
  TRUE ~ "Unknown"
)

cat("Groups:\n")
print(table(srt_merged$labels))
cat(sprintf("\nTotal: %d cells × %d genes\n", ncol(srt_merged), nrow(srt_merged)))
```

## Create CellChat object

```{r create-cellchat}
#| message: false

data.input <- GetAssayData(srt_merged, assay = "RNA", layer = "data")
cellchat <- createCellChat(object = data.input, meta = srt_merged@meta.data,
                           group.by = "labels")
rm(srt_merged, data.input); invisible(gc())
```

## Select CellChat database

```{r select-db}
CellChatDB <- CellChatDB.mouse
cellchat_keys <- list(
  c("Secreted Signaling", "ECM-Receptor", "Cell-Cell Contact"),
  "CellChatDB v2"
)
cellchat@DB <- subsetDB(CellChatDB, search = cellchat_keys, key = c("annotation", "version"))
cat(sprintf("DB interactions: %d\n", nrow(cellchat@DB$interaction)))
```

## Set var.features from DE markers

```{r var-features}
#| message: false

hsc_de    <- tar_read_raw(DE_TARGET_HSC)
mnc_de    <- tar_read_raw(DE_TARGET_MNC)
stroma_de <- tar_read_raw(DE_TARGET_STROMA)

sig_genes <- bind_rows(
  hsc_de    |> dplyr::filter(log_fc >= DE_LOGFC_MIN, padj < DE_PADJ_MAX),
  mnc_de    |> dplyr::filter(log_fc >= DE_LOGFC_MIN, padj < DE_PADJ_MAX),
  stroma_de |> dplyr::filter(log_fc >= DE_LOGFC_MIN, padj < DE_PADJ_MAX)
) |> dplyr::pull(feature) |> unique()

rm(hsc_de, mnc_de, stroma_de); invisible(gc())

cellchat <- subsetData(cellchat)
sig_genes_valid <- intersect(sig_genes, rownames(cellchat@data.signaling))
cellchat@var.features[["features"]] <- sig_genes_valid

cat(sprintf("Significant DE genes: %d  |  in expression matrix: %d\n",
            length(sig_genes), length(sig_genes_valid)))
```

## Compute communication probability

```{r compute-prob}
#| message: false

cellchat <- identifyOverExpressedInteractions(cellchat, variable.both = FALSE)
cellchat <- computeCommunProb(cellchat, type = "truncatedMean", trim = 0.1, raw.use = TRUE)
cellchat <- filterCommunication(cellchat, min.cells = 10)
cellchat <- computeCommunProbPathway(cellchat)
cellchat <- aggregateNet(cellchat)
cellchat <- netAnalysis_computeCentrality(cellchat, slot.name = "netP")

df.net <- subsetCommunication(cellchat)
cat(sprintf("Inferred interactions: %d   |   pathways: %d\n",
            nrow(df.net), length(cellchat@netP$pathways)))
```

## Network overview

```{r network-overview}
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 6

groupSize <- as.numeric(table(cellchat@idents))
par(mfrow = c(1, 2), xpd = TRUE, mar = c(1, 1, 2, 1))
netVisual_circle(cellchat@net$count, vertex.weight = groupSize, weight.scale = TRUE,
                 label.edge = FALSE, title.name = "Number of interactions")
netVisual_circle(cellchat@net$weight, vertex.weight = groupSize, weight.scale = TRUE,
                 label.edge = FALSE, title.name = "Interaction weight / strength")
```

## Per-group outgoing interaction strength

```{r per-group-outgoing}
#| fig-width: 14
#| fig-height: 10

mat <- cellchat@net$weight
par(mfrow = c(ceiling(nrow(mat) / 4), min(4, nrow(mat))), xpd = TRUE, mar = c(1, 1, 2, 1))
for (i in seq_len(nrow(mat))) {
  mat2 <- matrix(0, nrow = nrow(mat), ncol = ncol(mat), dimnames = dimnames(mat))
  mat2[i, ] <- mat[i, ]
  netVisual_circle(mat2, vertex.weight = groupSize, weight.scale = TRUE,
                   edge.weight.max = max(mat), title.name = rownames(mat)[i])
}
```

## Detected signaling pathways

```{r pathways-list}
print(cellchat@netP$pathways)
```

## All interactions — bubble plot

```{r bubble-all}
#| fig-width: 14
#| fig-height: 10

netVisual_bubble(cellchat, remove.isolate = FALSE, angle.x = 45)
```

## Signaling role heatmap

```{r signaling-roles}
#| fig-width: 14
#| fig-height: 8

ht_out <- netAnalysis_signalingRole_heatmap(cellchat, pattern = "outgoing",
                                             width = 12, height = 6,
                                             title = paste0(CONDITION_LABEL, " — outgoing"))
ht_in  <- netAnalysis_signalingRole_heatmap(cellchat, pattern = "incoming",
                                             width = 12, height = 6,
                                             title = paste0(CONDITION_LABEL, " — incoming"))
ComplexHeatmap::draw(ht_out + ht_in)
```

## Per-pathway analysis

```{r per-pathway}
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 8
#| results: hold

for (pw in cellchat@netP$pathways) {
  cat(sprintf("\n### %s\n\n", pw))
  tryCatch({
    par(mfrow = c(1, 1), mar = c(1, 1, 2, 1))
    netVisual_aggregate(cellchat, signaling = pw, layout = "chord",
                        title.name = paste0(pw, " — chord"))
  }, error = function(e) message(pw, " chord: ", conditionMessage(e)))
  tryCatch({
    print(netAnalysis_contribution(cellchat, signaling = pw) + ggtitle(pw))
  }, error = function(e) message(pw, " contribution: ", conditionMessage(e)))
}
```

## Pathway bubble plots

```{r pathway-bubbles}
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 6

for (pw in cellchat@netP$pathways) {
  tryCatch({
    pairLR <- extractEnrichedLR(cellchat, signaling = pw, geneLR.return = FALSE)
    print(netVisual_bubble(cellchat, pairLR.use = pairLR,
                           remove.isolate = TRUE, angle.x = 45) + ggtitle(pw))
  }, error = function(e) message(pw, " bubble: ", conditionMessage(e)))
}
```
